title: Fix client profile save loop by updating existing profile and stabilizing React Query state

requirements.summary: Update the Client Profile “Save Required Information” action to persist changes via an update flow (not initial profile creation) and prevent any browser page reload/refresh during save.
acceptanceCriteria: From the Client Profile page, clicking “Save Required Information” does not reload the browser page.

If the user already has a client profile, saving required fields updates the stored profile successfully (surname, middleName, lastName, yearOfBirth, idNumber, mobileNumber/phoneNumber, pinnedLocation).
After saving, reloading the app and revisiting the Client Profile page shows the newly saved values populated from the backend.
If saving fails due to validation/authorization, the UI shows a clear error message and does not reload the page.

file_operations.description: Add a dedicated React Query mutation hook for updating an existing client profile’s required fields using the backend update capability (use the authorization + core-infrastructure actor connection already provided). Ensure onSuccess invalidates the ['currentUserProfile'] query so refreshed data repopulates the form. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Switch “Save Required Information” to call the new client update mutation (instead of the initial save/creation mutation). Ensure the click handler cannot trigger a native form submission/page reload (e.g., by preventing default submission if applicable and/or ensuring the button behaves as a non-submit action). Show a clear, non-refreshing error state/message when the mutation fails due to validation/authorization and keep the user on the page. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Refactor the Client Profile page save behavior to use the new client-profile update mutation and ensure React Query invalidation/refetch updates UI state without navigation loops, with proper loading states.
acceptanceCriteria: ClientProfilePage no longer calls the initial profile-creation mutation to save required fields.
On successful save, the current user profile query is invalidated and the updated profile is shown (either immediately or after refetch) without the page appearing to refresh repeatedly.
The Save button shows a loading state while the mutation is pending and is re-enabled afterward.

file_operations.description: Ensure the new client required-fields update mutation hook cleanly integrates with React Query by invalidating/refetching ['currentUserProfile'] on success and surfacing errors for UI display, avoiding any manual navigation triggers. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Use the new update mutation for required fields; drive the Save button disabled/loading state from the mutation pending state; after success, rely on query invalidation/refetch (not navigation) so the profile completion gating in App.tsx stabilizes without repeated apparent refreshes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
